scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The theorem is proved by an explicit distance case analysis and checked independently within the package by exhaustive finite enumeration on a parameter grid. The finite computation is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The statement assumes p,q>=3 and ell>=1 and concerns vertex-distance k-metric generators only. The symmetric one-edge scalar 2-metric dimension was previously known and is not claimed as new. Literature search cannot exclude every obscure or unindexed overlapping source.
